text:
Life is only possible

reinvented.

The sun goes through the fields

and passes its golden hand

over the waters, over the leaves...

Ah, all bubbles

that rise from deep pools

of illusion... — nothing ever.

Ah, all bubbles

But life, life, life,

life is only possible

reinvented.

The moon comes, comes, removes

the chains from my arms.

I project myself through spaces

full of your figure.

Alone, balanced in time,

I detach myself from the swaying

that carries me beyond time.

Alone, in the darkness

I remain: received and given.

Because life, life, life,

life is only possible

reinvented.

translation.title: Life Is Only Possible...
translation.editorial_note: The translation keeps Meireles's refrain that life becomes possible only by reinvention, between sun, moon, chains, and darkness.
